correctness.rationale: Ordinary commutator in odd characteristic equals 2 times product of odd parts. In Lambda(V)/J^5, the wedge equations are v∧w=0 and v∧t+u∧w=0. For nonzero v, rank of u↦v∧u on Lambda^3 is r=choose(n-1,3). Disjoint degree-one strata give q^(2h)+(q^n-1)(q+1)q^(2h-r) commuting odd-component pairs; dividing by q^(2(n+h)) gives stated cp. For n<=5 r<=n-1 yields ratio>1; for n>=6 r>=n+4 yields ratio<1, q odd prime power. In E5 full, even and top degree are central; nonzero linear parts induce commutator rank 8, whereas zero linear parts give trivector wedge maps dual to alternating forms rank 0/2/4. Radical dimensions and GL_4/Sp_4 orbit orders give exactly four centralizer-dimension multiplicities. Characteristic 2 explicitly excluded.
